amendment_timing: Before endpoint cohort extraction, outcome research or labels; only technical archives/metadata inspected
science3_scope: Historical/input readiness and immutable origin candidate universe; not qualified clinical programs or locked cohort
origin_scope_hold_rule: Origin identity,regimen,population,arm-role and prior-risk unresolved dimensions must be resolved using origin-only evidence or held before any resolved label. Follow-up cannot admit or remove origin members.

assumptions: DATE denotes civil date of actual public posting of the used record version
Unknown conventional UTC offset within[-12,+14]hours; actual NLM timezone not asserted
Record-level posting does not date separate results versions or AACT enrichment
posting_date_policy.sensitivity: UTC-calendar day assumptions may be separately reported; do not choose after outcomes

held_followup_rule: Recover eligible earlier version or retain missingness; never treat unknown as negative, change origin membership or silently extend cutoff
input_coverage_requirement: Retain restored table/row/identifier/date audit plus unknown source-version/absence/reporting-lag limitations; no whole-world completeness claim
endpoint_truth: Registry start,enrollment,dosing and clinical efficacy remain distinct; no outcome automatically inferred
next_stage_gate: Only after Science3 report validates, freeze a separate read-only extraction/review/search protocol before any endpoint cohort query
